tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, with no exception for development. Where testing needs certificates, the project uses self-signed certificates, so verification stays on and is not switched off to make tests pass. This sits alongside the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere, with no plain-text exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
